DHAKA, Sept 5, 2022 (BSS) - A three-day "International Fish Fair" was inaugurated at Bremen in Germany on Sunday.

Md Mosharraf Hossain Bhuiyan, Ambassador of Bangladesh in Germany, inaugurated the Bangladesh pavilion in the fair, said a press release here today.

For the very first time, Bangladesh is participating in the fair to promote Bangladeshi fisheries for the German market.
